quality_notes: ONS territorial, residence or production, and consumption or footprint accounting bases remain explicitly separate.
ONS corrected and revised publications preserve correction status; superseded statements are not silently reused.
DfT SAF and RTFO fifth-provisional 2025 data remain provisional and November 2026 final releases remain future.
The cancelled RTFO 2026 fourth-provisional announcement is explicitly guarded and is not counted as an observation.
Vehicle registrations and EV charging infrastructure remain activity, stock or infrastructure evidence rather than direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
Ofgem BUS applications, vouchers, grants, eligibility and guidance remain administration or policy evidence rather than measured emissions reductions.
DESNZ conversion factors, UK ETS factors, allowances and market information remain calculation, compliance or market evidence rather than parcel measurements.
Local-authority and facility-level aggregates are not assigned to individual parcels.
Pollutant metrics are not silently substituted for greenhouse-gas metrics.
Publication date, reference period, unit, denominator, stock-flow semantics and method version are explicitly guarded.
No unsupported conversion, future-release observation or individual parcel emissions value was inferred or produced.
